items.source: Callback being invoked after a domain object is materialized from a Document when reading results.
items.translation: 在读取结果时，回调会在从Document反序列化域对象后被调用。

items.source: Entity callback method invoked after a domain object is materialized from a Document.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在从Document反序列化域对象后被调用。

items.source: Entity callback method invoked after a domain object is materialized from a Document. Can return either the same or a modified instance of the domain object.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在从Document反序列化域对象后被调用。可以返回原始域对象的实例或其修改后的版本。

items.source: a Publisher emitting the domain object that is the result of reading it from the Document.
items.translation: 一个Publisher发出从Document读取该域对象的结果。

items.source: entity - the domain object (the result of the conversion).
items.translation: entity - 领域对象（转换后的结果）。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
